It deliberately does not cover a separate, harder timing bug (double-addnode / ThreadOpenAddedConnections) mentioned in the same issue. A contributor gave a concept ACK but asked the author to rewrite an apparently LLM-generated description; the author has been silent for 79 days and also never answered achow101's question about why the PR remains in draft.
